{{Quote|Were you on Kiffu during the Annexation?''"<br />"''No. Master Tengrove, the Jedi Watchman of that sector, found me the year before.|[[Larin Moxla]] and Shigar Konshi|<ref name="TOR:FA" />}}
'''Tengrove''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and the [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Watchman]] of [[Kiffu/Legends|Kiffu's]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]]. A [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Annexation of Kiffu]], in which the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] forcibly took control of the [[Kiffar/Legends|Kiffar]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Tengrove discovered the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Kiffar [[Shigar Konshi]] and took him to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Konshi went on to be the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]].<ref name="TOR:FA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tengrove was mentioned in the [[2010]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]].<ref name="TOR:FA" />
